metadata.scope: all selected views in four GPT-OSS recovery union manifests
metadata.rubric: Pass when sensible, coherent, and complete. Accuracy, fabrication, unsupported claims, and source-grounding errors alone do not fail. Reject only actual nonsense/incoherence, truncation/incompleteness, loops/degenerative repetition, reserved/Harmony/control-token leakage, or formatting corruption severe enough to impair meaning.

reasons: Formatting and language corruption materially impair passages (for example `true SIAGD`, `pregnant floodgate happy`, and `bruise on the behavemachine`).
Multiple passages are nonsensical or garbled (`autoimmune TIPA`, `CFAT`, `argargometer`) rather than merely inaccurate.
Meaning is impaired by recurrent garbling such as `argon- argon obran`, `Serotonine`, and `heparidation`.
